en: I'm in my late 30s and tend to walk a lot when I go out with my kids on weekends. Comfort comes first for me with sneakers, so I usually wore New Balance or ASICS. This was my first DARIMATI purchase, and I got them because I liked SAND BEIGE. I ordered size 240, but the front of the shoe is pretty roomy, so they felt a little big at first. Once I adjusted the laces, though, they weren't particularly uncomfortable to walk in. I walked around the park with my kids for about two hours last weekend, and they were fine. These aren't shoes that feel super soft underfoot. I really like the design. The light color makes them a bit of a hassle to keep clean, but I think I'll wear them a lot for everyday outings.

Are sneakers allowed to be this cute lol I bought them for the gym, but lately I've been wearing them to work more haha They look good with beige slacks, and they're surprisingly not awkward with a dress either!! They were fine for workouts too, but the design is definitely my favorite thing about them❤️

I think comfort matters most in sneakers, so I mostly wore Skechers or New Balance. This was my first time buying DARIMATI, and I tried them because I liked the design. I mostly wear them for grocery shopping or walks. I like that there's room across the forefoot so my feet don't feel cramped. At first, the cushioning was firmer than I expected and felt a little unfamiliar, but I got used to it after a few days. I bought size 250, and there's a little extra room at the front for my feet. They seem to fit better with thick socks. They don't look overly sporty, so they go well with jeans too. I'm planning to wear them on our upcoming family trip. I don't know yet if they'll be comfortable for long days of traveling, but they're fine for everyday wear.

Turns out there are sneakers that fit even my super wide feet^^ I always have such a hard time choosing sneakers. If I buy based on my foot length, they're tight across the forefoot, and if I go up a size, my heels slip, so it's always tricky. Honestly, I was skeptical when I ordered these too, but I was surprised by how roomy they were across the forefoot lol I wore them to Seoul Forest with my family over the weekend, and it was nice not having my toes squished~ With my old sneakers, I'd want to take them off every so often on long walks, ugh. If you're expecting really plush cushioning, these might feel a little different, but I actually like this firm, supportive feel. I haven't worn them for over a month yet, but I'm really happy with them so far^^ I'm tempted by the other colors too~

I wear 270 in Nike and 265 in New Balance. My feet are on the wide side, and my usual workout split is about 70 weights and 30 cardio. I ordered 260, and there's a comfortable amount of extra length, with plenty of room across the forefoot. I need to tighten the laces a little to keep my feet secure. My old running shoes had cushioning that was too squishy for lower-body workouts, which was uncomfortable, but these feel firmer underfoot. I think they look better in person than in the photos. The color doesn't stand out too much for everyday wear either. One downside is that the front of the shoe looks a little wide, which might not be everyone's thing.

I have high insteps, and finding shoes is seriously so hard, ughhh. I usually wear 245 but ordered 240, and they're comfortable once I loosen the laces a little over my insteps!!! My toes aren't squished either, and the color is pretty, so I'm happy so far🥹 Maybe there's just a tiny bit of extra length at the front? But it doesn't bother me when I walk haha

I work out 3 times a week at F45. With workouts where you're constantly switching movements, like burpees and squats, I've realized shoe choice matters more than I thought. I used to wear running shoes, but I felt a little unstable when landing after jumps. With DARIMATI, I like the feeling of my whole sole making contact with the floor. I'm especially happy with them for side-to-side movements. I've only worn them twice so far, so I can't speak to durability. They also aren't the kind of shoes that feel really light. I think they're worth trying if you do both workouts and light running.
OYSTER GREY is seriously so pretty lol White sneakers felt like too much to deal with, and I already have too many black ones, so I picked these. They look good with jeans too.

I've only been going to the gym for two months, and it turns out I picked the wrong shoes right from the start lol My feet kept feeling wobbly when I did squats in my usual running shoes, so I looked around and found DARIMATI! The shoes have a pretty unusual shape, but I liked OYSTER GREY, so I went with them haha So far, my feet feel less wobbly during lower-body workouts than before!! I also tried about 15 minutes on the treadmill, and that was fine too. But these aren't super plush shoes. I actually like them better this way🤍

I walk a lot and go to the gym on weekends. I got tired of switching between two pairs of sneakers, so I looked around and bought these. At first, I chose them just for the design, but after trying them on, my favorite thing is how comfortable the front of my feet feel. My feet are on the wide side, and some shoes squeeze my little toes on long walks. These feel less cramped. The heels did feel a little loose at first, though, so I retied the laces. I think they'll be fine as long as you choose the right size.

My ankles are on the weak side, so I pay a lot of attention to the soles when buying shoes. I've had shoes that were actually uncomfortable because they were too soft, but these are pretty firm. I've only tried them for machine workouts and walking on the treadmill, and they were fine. I'll wear them a bit more before making up my mind.

I bought these for the gym, but I was surprised by how much better they go with everyday clothes than I expected lol They're cute with workout clothes, but they look good with wide-leg pants too. I guess the downside is that the light color will probably show dirt pretty easily? haha Oh, and they looked big at first, but once I put them on, they weren't as bulky-looking as I expected!

I have flat feet and wide feet, so I'm always careful about buying shoes. I mostly wore Skechers and New Balance, and I used Nike running shoes for workouts. I got interested in DARIMATI after reading that they could be used for both running and strength training. I usually wear 250~255 and ordered 250. There's room around my toes, and the fit over my insteps was fine once I adjusted the laces. They feel firmer underfoot than my old sneakers. I walked on the treadmill for about 20 minutes and tried the leg press, and I was happy with them. If you prefer sneakers with soft cushioning, though, these might feel a little unfamiliar at first. I'm going to wear them for a few more days too.

I bought these for a trip~ I usually wear 240, and I heard they run big, so I went back and forth but ended up getting 240. They're roomy and comfortable across the forefoot. My feet are pretty thin, though, so I do feel like there's extra space at the front. I haven't walked in them for a long time yet, but they were fine for a walk around the neighborhood. I like the color too^^

Ahh the color is seriously so pretty, I could cry. I wanted SAND BEIGE sneakers and spent ages looking before choosing these, and in person they look closer to cream!! I usually wear 235, but I ordered 230. My feet are on the wide side, so I love that they're not tight at the front lol I bought them for workouts, but they look so good with jeans that I'll probably just wear them every day🥹🤍

I bought them for the color, but they feel pretty decent on too. I usually wear them for walks and light exercise. They're comfortable with plenty of room across the forefoot, though the shoes themselves do look a little big.

I usually wear sneakers for a long time once I buy them, so I compared several brands before getting these. I mostly use the machines at the gym, then walk on the treadmill for about 30 minutes afterward. My old shoes were narrow at the front, so my toes felt cramped after workouts, but these have a little more space. The cushioning is firmer than I expected, and I'm happy with it. My one issue is the sizing. I usually wear 265, and after debating between 260 and 270, I chose 260. The length is fine, but they feel a little tight over my insteps with thick socks. I wish they came in 265 too.

Leaving this here because I figure people with wide feet will have a hard time deciding on a size haha I wear 250 in Nike and 245 in New Balance, but I ordered 240 in DARIMATI! At first, I worried 240 might be too small, but there's more room around my toes than I expected. I did have to loosen the laces a bit over my insteps to get comfortable~ I tried a lower-body workout at the gym, and they were fine since they're not too soft underfoot. I do think sizing will depend on your foot shape!!

I run a cafe, and I'm often on my feet for more than 8 hours a day. I've always looked for sneakers with plush cushioning, but DARIMATI feels a little different. At first, they were firmer underfoot than I expected, and I wondered if I'd made the wrong choice. After wearing them for a few days, I do like that they don't squeeze the front of my feet. On days when I stand for a long time, the bottoms of my feet sometimes feel a little tired, so I think I need to wear them more to see. I usually wear 245 but bought 240, and the length doesn't really bother me. I'm happy with the design. One small downside is that, since they're SAND BEIGE, the fronts get dirty easily when I wear them at the cafe.

I usually wear 250. I have average insteps and fairly narrow feet. I bought 250, and there's a lot of extra room at the front. My feet feel like they move around a little inside the shoes during workouts, so I tighten the laces. I like the design and color, but going down a size might have been better for my feet. If you have narrow feet, I'd suggest checking the sizing carefully.
My insteps are on the high side, but these are fine once I adjust the laces. The cushioning is more firm than plush. After a few days, I'm getting more used to them than when I first put them on~

I found out about these because some people at my gym wear them for workouts. I thought they looked cute, so I looked them up, and I bought them after reading they could be used for both running and weights. I have flat feet and fairly wide feet, so finding shoes is tricky for me. Compared with my other workout shoes: running shoes (good cushioning, but a little squishy for weights) / training shoes (firm underfoot, but too narrow and uncomfortable) / DARIMATI (roomy across the forefoot and moderately firm underfoot). I bought 240, and the size fit well. I walked on the treadmill for about 15 minutes after my personal training session, and they were fine. They were a little tight over my insteps at first, so I retied the laces. My one complaint is that they almost feel too nice to only wear for workouts? lol I'm going to try wearing them casually too.

My sneakers always wear down on the outside first. So I pay attention to the soles, and so far I like how firm they feel underfoot. I've been wearing these every day to walk my dog. I usually wear 235 but ordered 230, and the length fits well. They do feel a little tight over the top of my foot, so I tied the laces loosely. I like the design more than I expected.

I've tried so many sneakers, but finding shoes that fit my feet is really hard. I've sprained my ankles a few times before, so when I buy shoes, I pay more attention to how stable they feel underfoot than to the cushioning. My old shoes were light and comfortable underfoot, but sometimes felt a little unstable during workouts. When I first put on DARIMATI, the cushioning felt firmer than I expected, but personally, feeling supported matters more to me, so I was happy with that. I usually wear 240 and ordered the same size, but there's a little extra room in both the length and width. I thought about exchanging them for 230, but the width is comfortable as is, so I decided to keep them and wear thick socks. I mainly use them for machine workouts and light walking at the gym. Shoes alone probably won't solve my ankle issues, but I like how stable these feel when I'm wearing them. If you like a snug fit, though, I'd choose your size carefully.

If you have high insteps, PLEASE read this!!!!!!!! Wow, I'm seriously someone who strikes out every time I buy shoes because of my high insteps, sobbb. I got 240, and for once they don't press down on the tops of my feet!!! I'm so happy about this lolllll. I don't have to tie the laces super tight either, and the shoes don't look as big as I expected. At first I did wonder if there was a little too much room in the front!! But once I tied the laces and walked around, they were fine. They're cute, so I'm happy for now🥹❤️

I found out about these after seeing someone I work out with at F45 wearing them haha. I was looking for workout shoes too, and they looked so cute that I asked about them! They said they wear them for both running and weights, so I got curious 👀 The bone next to my big toe sticks out a bit, so even slightly narrow shoes are uncomfortable for me, ugh. I usually wear a half size, around 255, but I heard these run a little big, so I ordered 250. There's plenty of room across the forefoot, so they don't press on my big toe, which I love!! I wore them to class for the first time today, and they felt a bit different from my old shoes during burpees and squats. I've only worn them for one class, so I'll have to see how they go, but I really like them 🫶🏻 They look good with my workout clothes too
The grey color is so pretty~ I hated how all the comfortable shoes looked clunky, but I think these would look good with jeans too haha
The grey looks nice. I like that they're sneakers without looking too much like gym shoes lol. White is a pain to keep clean and I already have black, so I've been looking for a color like this

I work on my feet all day, so I bought these while looking for comfortable sneakers. I've worn them for about a week while working in the store. The roomy width is comfortable, and the soles are nicely firm. The area over the top of my foot did feel a little stiff at first. Loosening the laces helped. They look good with black pants, and the design is easy to wear. I'll have to wear them longer to see how well they hold up.

Size: Usually wear Nike 275, New Balance 270. Bought DARIMATI 270. A little extra length, comfortable width. Cushioning: Not too soft, nicely firm. Weights: Fine for machines, dumbbells, and regular squats. Cardio: Fine for about 3km on the treadmill. Haven't tried long-distance running yet. Fit: Not much pressure over the top of my foot. Laces need adjusting. Downside: Heavier than I expected. I think they work well for my goal of keeping just one pair of shoes at the gym for workouts.

I requested an exchange, and they handled it really quickly. Other places take forever with exchanges . I'm going to start wearing these to work out today. I'll work out in them for about a week and leave a review

I've been running for about a month, and at first I wore these regularly just for workouts, at least 3 times a week. They still feel springy and comfortable, so now I wear them every day! Haha. I bought a pair as a gift for someone I know too, and they say they're getting lots of use out of them and people keep asking where they bought them haha
They're comfortable, so I've been getting good use out of them. The adjustable laces make them easy to put on and take off
They feel really stable no matter what I use them for, and the design is cute. Great value for the money.

My daughter and I do HYROX together, and I'm a mom in my 50s. We tried DARIMATI sneakers first and were so happy with them that I bought another pair for my husband. The grip is really good, and they're good for running too. I'd like to order a pair for my son later if his size is available. My husband normally wears 275, but I ordered 270, and he says they fit perfectly and feel good.
I was trying to choose between a bunch of flashy running shoes when I happened to find these and bought them. Nice, clean grey 👍 My feet are on the wide side, and my usual size fits comfortably.
I really like them
Thanks for the fast shipping ^^~
I bought these for my son to wear running, and he says they're comfortable and he likes them
I gave these to my son, and he says they feel really good on and are very comfortable. I just wish there were more colors. Really nice.

My dad usually wears size 265 because of his bunions, and he has wide feet and high insteps too. After some debate, I ordered 270, but they were so roomy his heels were slipping out. I was worried 260 might be too snug, so I asked about sizing and an exchange. They were really helpful, and he's been wearing the 260 he exchanged them for happily.

Since these are performance shoes, I wasn't expecting much from the design, but they're clean and cute. They don't come in half sizes, so even though I wear 235 in sneakers, I bought 240, and they're a little big. That's my only disappointment.
They're comfortable to run in with no discomfort
My feet are on the wide side, so these are a bit narrow for me for the size haha. The design is nice, and I'll get good use out of them
The cushioning is good, so they don't put strain on my knees, and they're light, so I wear them a lot day to day too.
The fast shipping was nice. I have wide feet, so I usually go up 5mm, but these don't come in 5mm increments, so I tried 80, and they don't feel tight
Shipping was fast, which was nice~ I asked about getting the end part out, and they sent a really kind reply☺️
I'll get good use out of these, thank you

I love them. For CrossFit, they keep me firmly planted with great grip and no feeling of tipping backward. When I walk or run, they feel firm but give me enough support without feeling harsh, so they're seriously comfortable
I like them~~ Hope you sell lots~~
My husband tried them first and said they were comfortable, so I ordered a pair for my son in elementary school. He has wide feet and high insteps, but he says they're comfortable

I thought 40 would be too small, so I ordered these planning to return them if they were too big. They fit fine with fuzzy sleep socks. Most of all, the heel area feels really good, and they're light, so I don't think they'll be too uncomfortable for running. I ordered because the reviews were good, and I like the cute design too. I hope they're as comfortable on my feet as the reviews say

I bought these for strength training and cardio, and I like how comfortable they are. My old sneakers were flexible, while these definitely feel pretty stiff. They're comfortable for running on the treadmill too, which I like
Light and comfortable. They fit true to size
They were snug at first, but after a few days of wear they stretched a little, which is nice. Mostly use them at the gym

This is my honest review of shoes I paid for myself. Background I tend to injure my ankles pretty often, and I'd frequently get pain around my Achilles tendon or IT band after running. I'm writing this after running about 5~10km in these DARIMATI running shoes around 10 times. Pros 1. Ankle stability ★★★★★ Of all the running shoes I've worn, these feel like they hold my ankles the most securely. I used to get discomfort around my ankles or Achilles tendons when I ran several days in a row, but since wearing these, I've been able to run on consecutive days without pain so far. Personally, this is what I'm happiest with. 2. Grip ★★★★★ Compared with my previous running shoes, the grip was really good, especially on wet pavement. I can definitely feel them gripping the ground securely, and I think that also helps my ankles wobble less and feel more stable. Cons 1. Weight ★★★ The cushioning is good, but these aren't light, snappy running shoes like carbon-plated shoes. The structure supporting the ankles is pretty firm and solid overall, so I think that adds some weight. If times or speed are your top priority, you might be a little disappointed. Overall I think these running shoes are a really good fit for people who regularly run about 5~10km a day. I personally think the way to keep running long term is to keep running steadily without getting hurt and build strength, rather than focus on times. By that standard, these worked really well for me. I was looking for shoes that would let me run steadily for a long time rather than fast shoes, and these feel exactly how I wanted, so I think I'll stick with them for a while.
They're comfortable, the color is pretty, and I think they'll be good for workouts.
A friend who does HYROX recommended these, so I bought them, and they're so comfortable and nice. I love how the cushioning is firm but bounces like a basketball! Haha
I bought these for my wife and daughter when they started working out, and they say they're comfortable and they like them~ The design is cute too~
I wear 260 in a wide size in New Balance, and these fit just right. True to size.

It's been too hot to try running outside yet. I've done strength training at the gym and some slow jogging on the treadmill, and nothing felt particularly uncomfortable. I'm a chubby woman with wide feet, and there's plenty of room across the forefoot. They run bigger than I expected, so I think your usual size should work! They were comfortable even with thick running socks! I'll have a better idea once I run outside, but they're light and the cushioning feels slightly soft but firm, so I think they'll be okay without putting too much strain on my knees!
I like how cool and thin the material is. Most of all, I like the simple design, and I've been using it for running. Thanks for a good product.
I ordered these because I heard they're stability shoes that support your ankles well. Looking forward to wearing them.
Fast shipping and really nice.
Good price and a good product.
The cushioning felt good on landing, but I'm used to wearing stiff shoes like hiking shoes, so my feet haven't adjusted yet~
I ordered after watching Yeoksaui Jaewon on YouTube. The wrong size arrived, but they responded and took care of it quickly.
Thanks for the fast shipping ^^~
I bought these for working out at the gym.
My ankles feel really comfortable, and these are perfect for both everyday wear and workouts. Shoes that perform this well at this price..they're seriously the best.

I usually picked running shoes based only on cushioning, but when I actually tried these on, the grip was much better than I expected. I was happy with how securely they held my feet, both for running and for exercises with lots of direction changes. Regular running shoes sometimes felt slippery or unstable, but I definitely noticed less of that with these. They're comfortable too, so my feet didn't feel strained even after wearing them for a long time. The design is clean, so I think I'll wear them a lot outside of workouts too. I'd recommend them if you're looking for sneakers that deliver on both function and design!!

They're so comfortable that I'm planning to buy some for my parents too! The grip is good during workouts, and they're great hybrid shoes. The price is decent too, so I've been recommending them to people around me👍
Really good. Good for running.
The shoes are comfortable. Hope you sell lots.
They look nice and are pretty easy to put on and take off. Other than being a little narrow for my feet, I like everything about them.

I bought matching pairs for my friend and me, and I'm so happy with them! They're great for workouts, and they're really comfortable because they support my ankles well haha. I especially like the soft cushioning underfoot.

I bought these because I heard the grip was good! They're seriously so comfortable, and the color looks nice and clean, so I think I'll wear them often day to day too! I bought them for running, and I love that the laces won't come undone haha.
The weather's been all over the place since they arrived, so I still haven't even worn them out.

Kicking myself for only finding out about DARIMATI shoes now.. First off, I could feel the ankle support as soon as I put them on, and the grip definitely seems to be on another level. Good quality. Thank you.

They're light and comfortable, so they're great for everyday wear as well as running. The landing support and cushioning are good, so they don't put strain on my knees. I think they'd make a nice gift for my parents.

I love how light it is. Thanks for sending a good product.

I bought these after watching Jisigi Wae? They're light, and it's nice that they include extra insoles..My kid likes them.
The finishing is neat. I tried them on briefly, and they fit comfortably. Looking forward to working out in them too.
First off, the comfort is perfect~^^And the reason the box is so big is that they thoughtfully include insoles you'd have to buy separately elsewhere~!!Everything is perfect~!!
I like how compact it is. I'll put it to good use.
Firm yet soft. Comfortable. The stability is the best.
Comfortable on my feet, light, and nice.
So comfortable and supportive.
I've worn these for running and everyday wear for a month, and they're so comfortable. My feet feel less tired.

If you run and do light weight training, I think you'll be happy being able to do it all in one pair.I recommend these well-balanced shoes!

Definitely comfortable on my feet and really good. I'll buy again.

They're more stable than I expected for lunges and wall balls, which is nice! Even when I go straight into running, they feel less wobbly than carbon-plated shoes. I'd been worried because of an injury, so I think these are good!
